objective: Durably record user launch directives: Apache Pulsar primary with Kafka/Redpanda/RabbitMQ first-class adapters; Kubewarden default with Kyverno first-class adapter; REST/OpenAPI, gRPC/Protobuf, and GraphQL generated or validated from one shared Rust-native contract source of truth.
implemented_claims: Canonical planning/spec files now record the 2026-05-25 launch architecture directives.
Planning closure contract now names GraphQL and shared contract-source authorities and forbids REST/gRPC/GraphQL drift from manual parallel schema maintenance.
Microservice manifest schema now permits GraphQL projection paths and shared contract source paths under contracts.
Schema registry now recognizes GraphQL SDL/resolver projections and records the shared contract authoring model.

Platform architecture now records Apache Pulsar as launch-primary messaging/eventing substrate and Kubewarden as default admission substrate, while preserving Kafka/Redpanda/RabbitMQ and Kyverno as first-class adapters.
explicit_non_claims: No broker deployment, Pulsar/Kafka/Redpanda/RabbitMQ adapter implementation, message compatibility test, runtime eventing path, or production messaging evidence is claimed.
No Kubewarden/Kyverno controller installation, policy compilation, admission execution, Kubernetes API call, or production admission evidence is claimed.
No Rust-native contract generator, OpenAPI/Protobuf/GraphQL artifact generation, resolver implementation, drift gate, or API runtime behavior is implemented by this ChangeSet.
Full ./bin/oya verify --ci-required is not claimed green unless freshly run and proven.
false_green_findings_closed: Avoided treating the current Helm IaC gate as implementation evidence for GraphQL/API contracts, messaging adapters, or admission-controller choice.
Corrected planning records so GraphQL is not a separate hand-maintained schema and Kyverno/Kafka wording does not imply default launch substrate status where user direction differs.
Planning-closure gate rejected treating required_api_first_rules as an open-ended directive list; the final record uses a dedicated api_contract_single_source_of_truth object instead.
known_gaps: Future ChangeSet needed for the actual Rust-native shared contract source and deterministic drift gate over REST/OpenAPI, gRPC/Protobuf, and GraphQL.
Future ChangeSets needed for Apache Pulsar primary runtime and Kafka/Redpanda/RabbitMQ adapters.
Future ChangeSets needed for Kubewarden default policies/controllers and Kyverno adapter parity tests.

findings: No secrets or tenant data touched; admission-policy direction is recorded with fail-closed future scope.

Initial planning-closure false-green risk was corrected after the gate rejected unexpected required rule IDs.
